audit_items.proof_trace: The `generation_roles` table defines `generation INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` (table.sql:37), which is a PostgreSQL-level UNIQUE+NOT NULL constraint. Even if two concurrent requests both pass the application-level SELECT pre-check (L21-33), only one INSERT can succeed; the second receives a primary key violation error caught at L57. No duplicate (generation, discord_role_id) rows can be committed, so the invariant holds unconditionally.
